description: Sharp 1D and 7D drawdown, a volatility shock, extreme liquidation pressure, breakdown structure, funding flipped extreme negative, strongly negative momentum. A textbook capitulation day — every capitulation rule clears.
how_this_was_generated: Computed by actually running Bitmomo_Regime_Input::validate() and Bitmomo_Regime_Classifier::evaluate() against normalized_input below — not hand-derived. Re-run any time the classifier or config changes.

expected.confidence_range_note: Score is 110/110 (max), clamped at CONFIDENCE_CEILING=97. A weaker real capitulation payload (e.g. only the sharp-drawdown + momentum rules clearing, no liquidation data yet) will legitimately score lower — assert 'within confidence_range', not an exact number.

notes: Same funding-rate evidence-text caveat as the other fixtures: '(-0.1%)' is what Bitmomo_Regime_Classifier::fmt() renders for funding_rate_pct = -0.05; read normalized_input.funding_rate_pct for the real value, not the evidence string.

liquidation_pressure='extreme' contributes +25 (vs +12 for 'elevated', +0 for 'none' or null) — the single biggest optional-field swing in the capitulation score. If Codex's feed cannot yet supply liquidation_pressure, capitulation is still reachable via the other five rules (85/110 max without it), but a genuine capitulation event with real liquidation cascades will score noticeably lower and less confidently without this field wired up. This is the strongest argument for prioritizing a liquidation_pressure source early in the runtime adapter.
